flight._doc: separate flight pool (same numbers as the resource block until named/tuned, OD-06); at ≤ warning_fraction the low-energy controller derives a descent speed from remaining height / remaining powered seconds; at zero energy a visibly forced controlled unpowered landing (DEVELOPMENT FALLBACK pending owner policy); no flight during active PvP; taking flight in PvE interrupts the active attack sequence; landing_margin_s = the controller aims to touch down that many powered seconds BEFORE the pool is empty so a low-altitude flyer lands under power

Looking up/down never changes altitude (the Spec B camera-pitch rule is removed).

navigation._doc: owner 2026-09-18 section 4: nearby click / tap-to-move. range_m is measured from the PLAYER (never from the camera ray origin) and is an explicitly PROVISIONAL starting value inside the owner's requested 20-35 m band (no approved value existed in the register; 30 is NOT a measured reference-game number). Range validation is separate from path length and from the bounded search budget (max_expansions). The plan runs over the same colliders / ground the integrator uses; the walker uses the ordinary moveVec, speed band, accel / decel and sliding - never a teleport or a position tween. step_max_m = the largest support-height change between adjacent route samples (a step or ramp is fine, a drop or a rise onto a deck is not). snap_m bounds the search for nearby free ground when the tapped point itself is blocked (the accepted, snapped point is what the marker shows). One re-plan when stuck, then a clear stop.
